headline: Teen researcher found Microsoft database bug exposing trillions of rows
summary: A teenage security researcher discovered a Microsoft database vulnerability tied to a lack of JWT token validation, gaining admin access to databases reported at roughly 17 to 17.3 trillion rows.

claims.statement: A teenage researcher found a Microsoft database vulnerability.
The exposed database held roughly 17 trillion rows.
The access was enabled by a lack of JWT token validation.
The researcher gained admin access to the databases.

discrepancies.explanation: Outlets give slightly different row counts for the exposed database, 17 trillion versus 17.3 trillion.
